plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Career and Technical Education Leadership, BAS' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/career-and-technical-education-leadership-bas/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid (Career and Technical Education Leadership Career Map), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. Admission requires a technical associate's degree from a regionally accredited institution. The published schedule's 1st-4th semesters each carry an unnamed 15-unit block — the catalog does not name courses for these rows; they are modeled as transfer-block choice slots with an honest note. If access to a supervised internship is not available, 6 units of upper-division electives may substitute for EDCT 411. Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid. This program can be completed online but may require in-person assignments or exams.
